ja356:2.1: ahañhimaṁ sāgara sevitantaṁ → ahaṁ himaṁ sāgarasevitantaṁ (bj)
ja356:2.2: pāṇi → pāṇiṁ (bj) | pāṇi vikiriya → pāṇiṁ vikīriya (sya-all)
ja356:3.3: jigīsaṁ koraṇḍiya hāhasi jīvalokaṁ → jigiṁsaṁ kāraṇḍiya hāyasi jivalokaṁ (bj) | jigīsaṁ koraṇḍiya hāhasi → jigiṁsaṁ kārandiya hāyasi (sya-all)
